salvo: salvo14/mig/s6 (9 Nov 2026), lot k-openai-2 (c2-openai). HarnessPro (recursive harness self-improvement, cost-aware), GPT-5.5 x Codex block: Table 2 (12 methods: Vanilla, Dynamic Cheatsheet, ReasoningBank, Sleep-time Compute, RHO, Balance, RHO+Iteration, HarnessPro Lite/Medium/Heavy; per benchmark P = pass rate %, C = mean cost $ per test task, T = execution time s; mean and standard deviation for HarnessPro) and Table 3 (ablations: P, C, CoP = cost-of-pass, on Terminal-Bench 2 and SWE-Bench Pro) and Table 4 (the token prices used, GPT-5.5 row). Each row is a SYSTEM (GPT-5.5 inside Codex plus a harness method), not the model alone. One measure per pass-rate cell; the cost C($) is the cost of the measure (mean cost per test task, tokens at the Table 4 prices = list-estimate); T(s) and CoP($) and the standard deviations are kept in the measure notes. Default reasoning effort high on all three benchmarks (written); 'RHO + low reasoning effort' fixes effort at low; 'RHO + dynamic routing' selects effort per task (variable). Route not written (Codex harness). The GLM-5.2 x Claude Code block is not OpenAI and not converted.
